label: Inkling 2 Mini (local)
harness: Claude Code, model served by llama.cpp on this laptop
notes: One unattended session of 203 minutes on an M4 Pro with 48 GB, 4-bit weights (IQ4_NL), a 100,000-token context and roughly 8 to 23 tokens per second. Shell access was limited to the test tool and read-only commands. It wrote about 2,000 lines over three hours before running the game once, and that first run loaded without errors.
